## Block Markup

This is a [**dynamic block**](/block-editor/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering/). It is rendered on the server and does not save HTML in post content.

In post content, it is stored as a block comment:

```html
<!-- wp:rss {"columns":2,"blockLayout":"list","feedURL":"","itemsToShow":5,"displayExcerpt":false,"displayAuthor":false,"displayDate":false,"excerptLength":55,"openInNewTab":false} /-->
```
